mode.description: For Lazyload, Lightbox and Link mode check out ARVE Pro. Only use normal when Pro is not installed!

grow.description: Expands video size after clicking the thumbnail (Lazyload Mode)

lazyload_style.description: Chose the look of the video preview for Lazyload and Lightbox modes!

reset_after_played.description: When enabled ARVE Pro will display the thumbnail again like it is shown before the video was loaded. When a video is displayed in a lightbox the lightbox will automatically close. If you are using Vimeo's "call to action" feature for example you want to disable this for vimeo.

hide_title.description: Useful when the thumbnail image already displays the video title (Lazyload & Lightbox modes).

thumbnail_post_image_fallback.description: In case ARVE Pro can not get a thumbnail, the posts Featured image will be used instead

fullscreen.description: Makes the Browser go fullscreen when opening the Lightbox. Optionally stay in Fullscreen mode even after the Lightbox is closed

seo_data.description: ARVE Pro helps you autofill the data so you do not have to manually enter things for every single video to make it complete.

controls.description: Note that not all video hosts provide this feature.

controlslist.description: controlsList attribute on <video> for example use nodownload nofullscreen noremoteplayback to hide the download and the fullscreen button on the chrome HTML5 video player and disable remote playback.

autoplay.description: Do not expect this to work! Browsers (especially mobile) or user settings prevent it, some video hosts do not support it at all. Only used in normal mode. ARVE will mute HTML5 video playback in case to make autoplay work for the broadest audience.

disable_links.description: Disable all click/touch events on the video container. Useful if you want to have links in your video description that should be clickable.

maxwidth.description: In pixels. If set to 0 (default) the $content_width value from your theme is used if present, otherwise the default is 900.

allow_referrer.default: youtube, youtubelist, vimeo, rumble, xhamster, kick
allow_referrer.description: Comma separated list of lowercase hosts that will set referrerpolicy="origin-when-cross-origin" instead of the default referrerpolicy="no-referer" on iframe. This will make video less private for the visitor as the host will be able to see on what website they are watching on but its needed for youtube, vimeo, rumble and possible others for domain restricted videos.

cache_thumbnails.description: No image hotlinks to video hosts. For Lazyload/Lightbox (Pro).

youtube_nocookie.description: Privacy enhanced mode, will NOT disable cookies but only sets them when a user starts to play a video.

sticky.description: Keep the video on the screen when scrolling.

sticky_max_width.description: A vw (viewport width) value is recommended. The default of 40vw tells the video it can never be wider than 40% of the screens width.

sticky_gap.description: CSS value (px, me, rem ...). Space between browser windows corner and pinned video.

sticky_navbar_selector.description: If you have a fixed navbar on the top if your site you need this. document.querySelector(x) for a fixed navbar element to account for its height when pinning videos to the top.

sticky_on_mobile.description: Stick the video to the top of screens below 768px width in portrait orientation. The Video will always be as wide as the screen ignoring the Stick Width and Stick Maxwidth settings.

sticky_position.description: Corner the video gets pinned to on bigger screens.

arve_link.description: Shows a small 'ARVE' link below the videos. Be the most awesome person and help promoting this plugin.

align_maxwidth.description: In px, Needed! Must be 100+ to work.

youtube_data_api_key.description: Required for fetching video data like title, description, duration, etc. from YouTube. Get it from the Google API Console.

always_enqueue_assets.description: Default=No ARVE will loads its scripts and styles only when the posts content contains a arve video. In case your content is loaded via AJAX at a later stage this detection will not work or the styles are not loaded for another reason you may have to enable this option

admin_bar_menu.description: For quickly accessing the ARVE settings page.

feed.description: Enable the plugin in RSS/Atom feeds? Disabling will not completely disable everything but it will use native WP behavior in feeds where possible.

gutenberg_help.description: Disabling this makes the interface in Gutenberg/Shortcode dialog much cleaner.

legacy_shortcodes.description: Enable the old and deprecated [youtube id="abcde" /] or [vimeo id="abcde" /] ... style shortcodes. Only enable if you have them in your content.
